description: Persona 4 Golden tracks played inside Catherine. Read from the player's P4G sound banks. replaces_cc_file: Catherine file to redirect so the game itself plays the track (null = the mod plays it over the scene).

rows.title: Backside of the TV
rows._notes: Plays during the Midnight Channel intro, over Catherine's silence before Night 1. wave_index = stream index in snd00_bgm.awb; recon lists the cue names from snd00_bgm.acb.

rows.title: I'll Face Myself -Battle-
rows._notes: Catherine keeps all music in data/sound/bgm.cpk (CRI), not one file per track, so the WAV redirect can't apply. Until the CPK route lands, the mod plays the track itself on the boss climb. wave_index = stream index in snd00_bgm.awb; recon lists the cue names from snd00_bgm.acb.
